exampleSentences.portuguese: Dependendo do dia, isso pode fazer diferença.

subject: Music, Concerts & Events
english: I could be persuaded, but mostly by the people and the atmosphere rather than the event alone.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se a companhia for boa, fico muito mais inclinado a alinhar.
exampleSentences.english: If the company is good, I am much more inclined to say yes.

subject: Music, Concerts & Events
english: I prefer events that feel thoughtfully put together rather than just loud and busy.
portuguese: Prefiro eventos que pareçam pensados com cuidado, em vez de apenas altos e cheios.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Para mim a intenção nota-se bastante.
exampleSentences.english: For me the intention is quite noticeable.

subject: Music, Concerts & Events
english: The more I understand why people are excited about it, the more likely I am to get drawn in too.
portuguese: Quanto melhor percebo porque é que as pessoas estão entusiasmadas com isso, mais provável é eu também entrar no espírito.

exampleSentences.portuguese: O entusiasmo contagia, se fizer sentido para mim.
exampleSentences.english: Enthusiasm is contagious, if it makes sense to me.

subject: Music, Concerts & Events
english: I like the idea of the event, but I suspect the practical side may matter more than the concept itself.

notes: Useful when deciding whether to go.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se for complicado demais, já muda tudo.

subject: Music, Concerts & Events
english: If we are going to commit to it, I would rather make a proper plan than leave everything vague.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quando fica tudo indefinido, normalmente complica.

subject: Music, Concerts & Events
english: I do not need it to be perfect; I just need it to feel worth the effort and reasonably enjoyable.

exampleSentences.english: Sometimes that is more than enough.

subject: Music, Concerts & Events
english: What I am looking for is less a spectacle and more a genuinely enjoyable shared experience.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Para mim a parte humana conta muito.
